text: はれた　ひは　そとにでて　かざんを　ながめるのが　にっかじゃ

structure.jp: かざんを　ながめるのが

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. かざんを　ながめるのが = 'gazing at the volcano (is...)'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing describes that thing. はれた　ひ = 'a day that has cleared up', a sunny day.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: そとにでて　かざんを　ながめる
patterns.explanation: Ending the first action in て joins it to the next one, like 'and then'. そとにでて　かざんを　ながめる = 'go outside and gaze at the volcano'.
